statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that coverage may be available through another insurer pursuant to coordination of benefits protocols
The purpose of the telemetry is to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias
The purpose of the telemetry is to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
